title: CTT Beats comes together with Lloyd laFlex, and Shxngie to deliver a new sound, “Kuzolunga”
htmlContent:
South African-based artist, CTT Beats, is a talented Drill, hip-hop, and amapiano artist who is fast in making a name for himself in the music industry. CTT Beats comes together with Lloyd laFlex and Shxngie to make a must-hear sound titled “Kuzolunga.”

CTT Beats, Lloyd laFlex, and Shxngie’s “Kuzolunga” is that amazing music that no words are needed for, as you get to feel the work in its entirety. The piece can brighten the darkest days with a blissful energy that feels good to hear for every second they give us.
